verdict.rationale: The Agents SDK is thoroughly documented as a public, programmatic Python/JS API (Agent, Runner, Tools, Handoffs, Guardrails, Sessions, Tracing, MCP support), letting an AI-native user drive it entirely through code rather than a GUI, and llms.txt/docs endpoints confirm machine-readable documentation is publicly served. missing for 10: no formal OpenAPI/machine-readable spec (probe shows 404s for openapi.json/swagger.json) and no independent third-party audit of API completeness beyond vendor docs.
